name: freshworks-developer-tooling
description: Freshworks Platform 3.0 app development, AI Actions integrations, publishing, and FDK management skills. Marketplace publish MCP config: **skills/fw-publish/.mcp.json** — on install you will be prompted for your Developer Portal JWT.

interface.shortDescription: FDK setup, Platform 3.0 apps, AI Actions, and marketplace publish.
interface.longDescription: Aggregate plugin for Freshworks marketplace development: install and manage FDK with fw-setup, build full apps with fw-app-dev, AI Actions integrations with fw-ai-app-dev, and publish with fw-publish via MCP. MCP template: **skills/fw-publish/.mcp.json**; configure Marketplace API token when prompted.

mcp_auth_token.title: Marketplace API token (JWT)
mcp_auth_token.description: API key from https://developers.freshworks.com/developer/ — find 'API key for Freddy AI Copilot VS Code plugin' section and click Copy.
